frames.production_cm: analysis axes x = subject left, f = forward, u = up; origin = frozen pelvis_root projected to the ground
frames.source_frame_cm: the same axes in the frozen v005 frame; production = source + (-0.11180, 5.72272, 0) cm
frames.blender_m: (x, -f, u) / 100 applied to production_cm (Z up, faces -Y, subject left = +X)
frames.handedness: the analysis frame is LEFT-handed (x × f = −u) because the Blender mapping negates one axis; frames below are right-handed in Blender and therefore have det −1 when written in analysis coordinates

meta.rule: internal centres = coordinate median of >= 2 independent surface definitions (A, B) and the frozen value (C); uncertainty = largest distance to any alternative; status usable (diagnostic) only if that is <= 1.0 cm. Construction joints are carried exactly and validated against the v005 surface. Numerical fit precision is not anatomical certainty.
meta.v003_crosscheck: the same measurement code re-run on the frozen v003 production read-back (same frame); delta = movement of the proposal. It shows method stability on the production surface; it is NOT accuracy of an inferred internal centre, and is 0 by construction for copied construction joints.
meta.t6_note: T-6 of the frozen package remains a surface-preservation check only.
